crowdingProxy.compatibleWithAnt4Autopsy: Same idea as ant4 autopsy; radius derived only from train-eligible data here, not from ant4 or final test.
crowdingProxy.definition: For each annotation, count same-image GT centers within radius = 1.5 * median(max(width,height)) from train annotations, in normalized coordinates.

keyFindings: v3 train has 222 images / 3731 annotations / 16.81 ants per image mean.
v4 train has 293 images / 3886 annotations / 13.26 ants per image mean.
v4 own-domain addition contributes 71 images / 155 annotations / about 2.18 ants per image plus 2 intentional negatives.
The v4 addition improved domain exposure but materially shifted added own-domain data toward sparse images.
Historical public Seq0007 and Seq0009 remain the strongest crowded/small-ant train sources and should be preserved, not replaced.
